verdict.rationale: Asana's own marketing names AI Studio as "Powerful no-code automations," and its platform docs mention rule actions, so a first-party no-code automation capability exists. The evidence is only brief labels, though: nothing shows that a non-developer can chain multiple steps (triggers, conditions, sequential actions) in one workflow. Zapier, n8n and similar directory listings are third-party tools and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of multi-step workflow building (chained triggers/conditions/actions) in Rules or AI Studio, details of the no-code builder experience, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build multi-step automations without writing code
